src: 胡安，胡安怎么会是胡安？
text: Huan, how could it be Huan?

src: 嘿，过来了。
text: Hey, here it comes.

src: 刺客全是皇家的人。马费纳，马费纳，马费纳，马费纳。不要，就是马费纳，马费纳就是活靶子。
text: The assassins are all from the Royal Family. Mafena, Mafena, Mafena, Mafena. No, I mean Mafena. Mafena is a sitting duck.

src: 县长大人，绑架豪绅，祸害县城百姓。
text: Your Honor, he kidnapped a wealthy magistrate and brought disaster upon the people of the county.

src: 就是你黄老爷家的。
text: It's from your Master Huang's family.

src: 我说你为什么不出钱剿匪？原来你是贼喊捉贼啊！
text: I was wondering why you wouldn't pay to suppress the bandits. So you're the thief crying 'Stop thief!'!

src: 你拿枪指着我。
text: You're pointing a gun at me.

src: 你拿枪指着我。
text: You're pointing a gun at me.

src: 你想跟我火并？
text: You want to kill me?

src: 你们看到了没有？这就是当麻匪的下场，就算是我亲爹也得死。死有应得。
text: Do you see? This is what happens when you're a bandit. Even my own father would have to die. He died a worthy death.

src: 造反！
text: Rebellion!

src: 马匪胡安又让黄老爷枪毙了五回，大义灭亲，杀人灭口，连累老身。
text: The bandit, Huan, was executed by Master Huang five times. He killed his own kin, silenced witnesses, and implicated this old woman.

src: 杀人灭口，你就是马匪的头子，张麻子。
text: To kill to silence the witness. So you're the leader of the bandits, Zhang Mazi.

src: 要是大义灭亲，那好吧。
text: If you're going to kill your own kin for the sake of justice, then fine.

src: 你出钱，我交税。好啊！
text: You pay the money, I'll pay the tax. Great!

src: 三天之后，
text: Three days later,

src: 一定给县长。
text: It must be given to the county magistrate.

src: 一个惊喜。
text: A surprise.

src: 汤师爷，他是胡万的恩人，现在又成了你的恩人。
text: Master Tang, he was Hu Wan's savior, and now he's your savior as well.

src: 你给翻译翻译。
text: You, explain it to me.

src: 什么叫惊喜？
text: What's a surprise?

src: 翻译翻译，什么叫惊喜？这还用翻译？
text: Let me translate for you. What's a 'surprise'? Does that even need translating?

src: 我让你翻译给我听，什么叫“你”？
text: I asked you to translate for me. What do you mean by "you"?

src: 惊喜！不用翻译就是惊喜。难道你听不懂什么叫惊喜？让你翻译翻译什么叫惊喜？惊喜翻译出来给我听！
text: Surprise! It's a surprise, no need to translate. Don't tell me you don't get what 'surprise' means. I'm telling you to translate 'surprise' for me! Translate 'surprise' and let me hear it!

src: 什么他妈的叫惊喜？什么什么？
text: What the fuck is a 'surprise'? What the...?

src: 他妈的，叫！他妈的！
text: Goddamn it! Shout! Goddamn it!

src: 惊喜！什么他妈的叫惊喜啊！惊喜就是三天之后，我出180万给你们重生剿匪，先杀我的腿！
text: A surprise! What the hell is a surprise?! The surprise is that in three days, I'll put up 1.8 million for you guys to raid the bandits. But first, kill my legs!

src: 明白了吗？这就是惊喜啊！
text: Get it? That's the surprise!

src: 肥肥。
text: Fatty.

src: 飞飞，惊喜就是三天之后，给你一百八十万两银子，出城剿匪，接上他的腿。
text: Feifei, the surprise is that in three days, I'll give you 1.8 million taels of silver to leave the city, fight the bandits, and get his leg back.

src: 大哥，这特么是惊喜啊！小弟我愿意等你三天。
text: Big bro, this is a f*cking pleasant surprise! I'm willing to wait for you for three days.

src: 黄老爷，康老爷是我的挚爱，你可不能夺我所爱啊！
text: Master Huang, Master Kang is my beloved. You can't take what I love from me!

src: 要人，要人！
text: Help! Help!
[Game sound]
